free_tier.stated: Free plan: '1 free active Studio (4 hour restarts)', 'Persistent storage (200 GB limit)'. Studio docs say the default Studio disk is 400 GB; pricing page caps the free tier at 200 GB.

retention.stated: Free Studio restarts every 4 hours (compute restarts, disk persists); auto-sleep after 10 min idle; free GPU hours come from 'up to 30 credits'; account data deleted after 6 months without login.

egress.terms: No egress meter or per-GB transfer price is published on the pricing page — free/public app serving on Studios is included in the plan.

tooling: SSH/SFTP into a Studio (docs: 'Connect any local IDE or SSH'), plus a documented public-port feature; `lightning` CLI and SDK. No rclone backend.
chaining: 1 Studio per free account with 200 GB persistent; N free accounts. Studios can be mounted as read-only 'datasets' shared across a teamspace, so one account can fan out many consumers.
